snippet.title: The Relic: First Guardian exclusive 8 minute gameplay - PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct
snippet.description:
Across the continent of Arsiltus lie countless dormant dungeons.
They are places where sealed Brutals still writhe, and where the secrets of a forgotten age remain. Explore the dungeons, and confront the forgotten tales.

A Brutal is not just a monster. Each carries its own tragedy and story,
and those tales will draw you, the adventurer, into the depths of darkness.
